title: ChittySchema Owner Manifest
description: Meta-schema for development/chittyschema/database-config.json. Validates the entire Schema Owner Manifest including the legacy databases[] simple shape and the rich tableOwners[] registry. This file is the contract between PR #5 (manifest) and every consumer of /api/owners.

$schema.description: Self-identifies the manifest as conforming to this meta-schema. Should be 'chittyschema://meta/manifest.schema.json' or the equivalent HTTPS URL.

databases.description: Backward-compatible simple shape (PR #5). Each entry declares a Neon/Postgres database, the env var carrying its connection URL, the services that use it, and a flat table → owner-service map.

tableOwners.description: Rich manifest (PR #5). The canonical answer to 'who owns this table?' across the ChittyOS ecosystem. Each entry must reference a database declared in `databases[]`.

envVar.description: Name of the env var carrying the connection string. MUST end in `_DB_URL` and be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Bound at runtime via `wrangler secret put`.

owner.description: Human-readable owning team or service group.

services.description: Services that read from or write to this database.

tables.description: Flat table-name → owning-service map (the legacy shape used by tables.ts).

table.description: SQL table identifier. Optionally schema-qualified (e.g. 'public.users' or 'canon.policies'). Defaults to 'public' schema.

service.description: Authoring service name. 'shared' is a sentinel for cross-cutting tables like audit_logs.

repo.description: GitHub repo of the form ORG/repo, e.g. CHITTYFOUNDATION/chittyledger.

authoringFile.description: Path within the authoring repo where the migration SQL or Drizzle definition lives. May start with '(TBD' to indicate intentionally tracked but not-yet-located authoring files.

canonType.description: P/L/T/E/A canonical entity type per chittycanon://gov/governance. Validated against canon.chitty.cc/api/ontology at runtime when canon is reachable.

semver.description: Strict semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH for the schema of this table. Bumps on shape change.

legalHold.description: If true, this table is chain-of-custody critical. Drift triggers a `schema.drift.legal_hold` event (alertable). Future legal-freeze mode blocks any schema change without explicit override.

stewards.description: GitHub team handle for schema review (e.g. '@chittyfoundation/ledger').

notes.description: Free-form note. Used to document namespace collisions and intentional special cases.
